pump_gap.title: No pump recorded
pump_gap.rule: On BMC's 2026 list of waterlogging spots, with the dewatering-pump cell blank
pump_gap.check: Confirm whether a pump is assigned, moved or no longer needed; record it before the monsoon

list_gap.title: Missing from BMC's list
list_gap.rule: Named by BEST or the Traffic Police, but not by BMC's own 2026 list
list_gap.check: Ask the ward office to confirm the spot and add it to the BMC list, or record why not

corroborated.title: Named by 2+ lists
corroborated.rule: Independent official lists agree on this place
corroborated.check: Pre-monsoon drain, culvert and outfall check

traffic_critical.title: Traffic diversion planned
traffic_critical.rule: Mumbai Traffic Police divert traffic here when it waterlogs
traffic_critical.check: Agree the alert contact with the traffic division before heavy-rain days

needs_location.title: Exact spot unknown
needs_location.rule: The official name could only be placed at neighbourhood level, or not at all
needs_location.check: Field-verify the exact spot and record its coordinates
